title: 第七章 一条一条数第八章 这是个秘密
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
唐斩月第一次参加拍卖会，想拍东西又怕钱不够，干脆找唐渊要，借口找的冠冕堂皇。
“我想给你和妈妈买礼物，但我手头有点紧。”
不过两分钟，一大笔钱便到账了。
唐斩月看着后面那串长长的零，笑得见牙不见眼，老爸大方！
唐渊：你妈妈喜欢漂亮的东西。
唐斩月：收到！
顿了下，她又问：妈妈怎么一直没回家？我给她发消息，她也没回。
唐渊：看着你心烦，回她爸妈家散心了。联系不上很正常，她把你拉黑了。
唐斩月：……
别说妈妈，她自己也很嫌弃“原主”，这哪是贴心小棉袄啊，这分明是报应的化身。
母女之间的矛盾，已经不是用礼物就能解决的了。但该买还是要买，而且要多多的买！
于是，接下来的拍品，唐斩月几乎不看价格，只要漂亮就买，出价就完了。
期间，温晚意看上了一条项链，裴烬川本想拍下送给她，但唐斩月一直加价。
拍卖价格很快便超出了项链本身的价值。
裴烬川冷脸放弃了。
温晚意有些失落，但还强撑着笑了笑，“没想到我跟斩月姐会喜欢同一样东西。”
贺兰逸恼火，“她就是针对你！”
魏谨言安抚道：“没关系，等下见面让唐斩月把项链送你好了，就当是她的道歉礼物。”
温晚意摇头，“算了，一条项链而已。”
魏谨言情绪复杂，“斩月什么时候能像你这么懂事就好了。”

唐斩月自然不知道有人惦记她还没到手的项链。
等拍卖会结束，她起身跟工作人员去签单、检查拍品，然后一样一样全都收进了空间钮。
刚办完手续出来，她就被人堵住了。
唐斩月微怔，随后神色自若地摸了摸赤璃，“我忙完了，走吧。”
她还真不是故意晾着人，只是任何事都有轻重缓急之分，在她看来，参加拍卖会比见他们重要多了。
几人都没动，一行五人，有三个都盯着赤璃看，脑子里有一瞬间是空的，很想问清楚这精神体是哪来的。
可别人都没开口，自己问的话，好像很在意一样。
温晚意和裴烬川则是在看她身边的人，他们想找到那个精神体的主人。
可惜一无所获。
“杵着干什么呢？”唐斩月一脸不耐烦，“还不带路。”
魏谨言和言煦之有些惊讶地看了她一眼，这语气实在不像平时的她。
几人心思各异地往电梯走去，一路上都没人开口说话。
唐斩月跟在他们身后，也乐得清净。
进入休息室后，温晚意直接坐在了直排沙发的中间位，四个男人则分别在她两侧落座，而后齐齐看向唐斩月，像是在给她施压。
唐斩月没理他们，用精神力拖了张单人沙发过来，就摆在他们正对面，然后优雅落座。
她一边给赤璃顺毛，一边漫不经心地扫过面前几人，着重看了眼魏谨言和言煦之。
一个黑发黑眸，神色严肃，穿搭古板，像个老派的绅士。
一个棕发棕眸，眼角带笑，气场温和，像个儒雅的贵公子。
content_en:
Tang Zhanyue participated in the auction for the first time. He wanted to buy something but was afraid of not having enough money, so he simply asked Tang Yuan to ask for it, making a high-sounding excuse.
"I want to buy you and mom a gift, but I'm a little short on money."
Within two minutes, a large sum of money arrived.
Tang Zhanyue looked at the long string of zeros behind him and smiled so hard that he couldn't even see his eyes. Dad is so generous!
Tang Yuan: Your mother likes beautiful things.
Tang Zhanyue: Got it!
After a pause, she asked again: Why hasn't mom come home? I sent her a message, but she didn't reply.
Tang Yuan: Seeing that you were upset, you went back to her parents’ house to relax. It's normal to be unable to contact her. She has blocked you.
Tang Zhanyue:...
Not to mention my mother, she herself despises the "original owner". This is not a caring little cotton-padded jacket. This is clearly the incarnation of retribution.
The conflict between mother and daughter can no longer be solved with gifts. But you still have to buy it, and buy more!
Therefore, for the next auction, Tang Zhanyue almost didn't look at the price. As long as it was beautiful, he would buy it and bid.
During this period, Wen Wanyi fell in love with a necklace. Pei Jinchuan wanted to take a photo of it and give it to her, but Tang Zhanyue kept raising the price.
The auction price quickly exceeded the value of the necklace itself.
Pei Jinchuan gave up with a cold face.
Wen Wanyi was a little disappointed, but she still managed to smile, "I didn't expect that Sister Zhanyue and I would like the same thing."
He Lanyi was annoyed, "She is targeting you!"
Wei Jinyan reassured her, "It's okay. Let Tang Zhanyue give you the necklace when we meet later. Think of it as her apology gift."
Wen Wanyi shook her head, "Forget it, it's just a necklace."
Wei Jinyan had mixed emotions, "It would be great if Zhan Yue could be as sensible as you."
Tang Zhanyue naturally didn't know that anyone was thinking about the necklace she hadn't gotten yet.
After the auction ended, she got up and went with the staff to sign the order, inspect the lots, and then put everything into the space button.
As soon as she came out after completing the formalities, she was blocked by someone.
Tang Zhanyue was slightly startled, then touched Chili with a calm expression, "I'm done, let's go."
She really didn't mean to show off to others, but everything had its own priorities. In her opinion, attending the auction was much more important than meeting them.
No one moved. Three of the five people in the group were staring at Chili. Their minds were empty for a moment, wanting to know where this spiritual body came from.
But no one else spoke, and when he asked, he seemed to care.
Wen Wanyi and Pei Jinchuan were looking at the people around her, trying to find the owner of the spiritual body.
Unfortunately nothing was found.
"What are you doing?" Tang Zhanyue looked impatient, "You're still not leading the way."
Wei Jinyan and Yan Xuzhi looked at her in surprise, and their tone was really unlike her usual tone.
Several people walked to the elevator with different thoughts, but no one spoke along the way.
Tang Zhanyue followed them, feeling happy and peaceful.
After entering the lounge, Wen Wanyi sat directly in the middle of the straight sofa. Four men sat on either side of her, and then all looked at Tang Zhanyue, as if to put pressure on her.
Tang Zhanyue ignored them, used his mental power to drag a single sofa over, placed it directly opposite them, and sat down elegantly.
While smoothing Chi Li's hair, she casually glanced at the people in front of her, focusing on Wei Jinyan and Yan Xuzhi.
A man with black hair and eyes, a serious look, and old-fashioned clothes, like an old-fashioned gentleman.
He has brown hair and brown eyes, a smile in his eyes, and a gentle aura, like an elegant nobleman.
